item.title: Public consultation closes tomorrow on Lough Swilly oyster farming plans
item.description: The public consultation on the proposed oyster and mussel farming developments at Lough Swilly closes tomorrow. The plans have sparked controversy locally, with concerns raised about their potential environmental and community impact. Submissions to the Department of Agriculture, Food and the Marine must be made before the deadline.
